name: luxurious-rose-gold-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: Create a polished dressing-room mirror selfie with reflective rose-gold fashion.

prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic fashion mirror selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with jet-black Hollywood-wave hair, natural porcelain-toned skin, soft feline-shaped eyes and confident neutral expression; wearing an opaque rose-gold metallic sequin dress with matching choker and refined jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level seated mirror selfie, legs crossed naturally, one arm on a vanity and the other holding a white smartphone; cream textured walls, ornate gold frame, plush beige seating and white-clothed table.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour indoor glow, diffused shadows and sparkling highlights across sequins and jewelry; sophisticated polished mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm, f/1.8, waist-up medium shot, 8K photorealism, detailed skin and sequin edges, ray-traced reflections.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic mirror selfie of a clearly adult original woman with jet-black Hollywood waves wearing an opaque rose-gold metallic sequin dress and refined jewelry, seated in an opulent cream dressing room with ornate gold frame and plush beige seating, warm diffused light, realistic reflections and high-detail fashion editorial finish.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, transparent dress, logos, text, watermark, distorted fingers, plastic skin, broken reflections
